svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Two 50 cubes. Drill 25 through both on one axis (the screw axis).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper block: counterbore 47 x 12 on top for the 51105 thrust bearing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nut block: counterbore for the bronze flanged nut; 2 M6 hold it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both: drill and tap two opposite faces M16, 25 deep, on the centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square to the screw hole; screw in 16 pins with a shoulder.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: upper block hangs in the bracket forks; nut block sits between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the two lever plates on the arm frame. Both pivot on their pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each block swings freely on its pins without play over 0.5.
